messages:
lena: Quick heads up — vendor_jp just messaged: one of our H100 allocation shipments is slipping ~3w. They offered two options: (A) partial air shipment for 8 units (higher cost) and sea for the rest, or (B) wait full sea shipment. Need decision this afternoon — affects Dedicated pool availability and burn rate. PO 87329 on file.
sam: Oof. What's our burn projection if we wait?
vendor_jp: Confirming: sea ETA now ~2027-04-18 (was 2027-03-28). Air option ETA ~2027-03-31 for 8 units. Air surcharge ~= +$1,200/unit. We can split AWB and consolidate RMAs at depot if helpful.
mia: Do we have customs/HS code OK for the air split? EU rules could add delays if paperwork not perfect.
operations-bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-2027-0442 (auto) for vendor_jp shipment split.
lena: Sam — short answer on burn: if we don't top up, Dedicated pool QPS drops ~22% in 10d. If we air 8 units, we stay flat for 18d.
sam: Thanks. I prefer minimizing service impact — vote air for the 8 units. Can we confirm vendor will separate serials and provide depot-ready packaging/photos for RMA?
vendor_jp: Yes. We'll send separate AWB and a manifest with serials and depot acceptance notes. Example manifest line: `AWB: JP123456789, PO:87329, SKU:H100, SN:SN-A1B2C3`
vendor_jp: Also note — if you consolidate RMAs later, we can bundle returns under one claim to reduce customs paperwork. That'd require depot to hold units together for 48h.
mia: For EU customs: please include HS code 8471.80.2000 and full commercial invoice. Otherwise we'll see import hold.
alex: We have 6 loaner H100s in staging rack-2. Can we extend loaner window 14d to cover the gap? I'll need ops approval to keep them on racks.
amy_finance: What's the incremental cost run for air + loaner extension? Need a quick estimate to approve PO amendment.
lena: vendor_jp: provide total delta (air surcharge + handling) in one line item. Alex: we can cover loaner extension from ops buffer for 14d if finance approves delta.
vendor_jp: Air delta total = $9,600 (8 units * $1,200). Handling & split manifest fee = $350. Invoice amendment request ready if you confirm.
amy_finance: If total delta <= $12k, we can approve as a change order against PO 87329. I'll sign if vendor sends amendment doc and new invoice.
sam: Ops-wise I approve air for critical pool. Alex — please keep loaners on racks and tag them with `temp-swap-87329`.
alex: Tagged and noted. I'll log acceptance photos and put them in /shared/ops/provisioning/87329.
lena: vendor_jp — proceed with air split for 8 units. Please attach AWB + manifest + amended invoice by EOD. Also: RMA handling preference: consolidate returns at NL depot (AMS) for final inspection.
vendor_jp: Confirmed. Air booking made: AWB JP123456789 (ETA 2027-03-31). Sea booking remains on master BKG SE987654321 (ETA 2027-04-18). Amended invoice sent to amy_finance@redwood.com.
mia: I'll pre-clear customs docs once manifest/invoice lands. Ops: schedule depot slot for AMS on 04-01 to accept air.
operations-bot: Deploy note: canary routing will keep 20% traffic on fallback model for 48h post-arrival to monitor perf.
lena: Great. Sam — track pool metrics, call if degradation >5%. Everyone else: thumbs if ack. :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup:
amy_finance: :thumbsup:
vendor_jp: :thumbsup:
alex: :thumbsup:
mia: :thumbsup:
lena: Logged. Closing thread after docs confirmed.
